The Nopopo Daikon that Umama grows...
They're absolutely exquisite.

rows.label: tlk41700122_05_msg0002
rows.name:
Their shape is a bit distinctive, and
I feel guilty when I cut them...but
it's also a good stress reliever...

rows.label: tlk41700122_05_msg0003
rows.name:
Above all, they taste great...
They're perfect inside and out.

rows.label: tlk41700122_05_msg0004
rows.name:
I'm so glad I lent that field
to Umama.
